# run
# echo
# env NAME=value
# env DOLLAR=a$NAME b${NAME}
# note one pass only: what a value holds is not expanded again, and a dollar
# note that opens no name is text
>>> f.rr
-- expands both forms, adjacent --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

${NAME} $NAME $NAME${NAME}
-- does not re-expand a value --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

${DOLLAR}
-- leaves dollars that are not names --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

{"price":"$5"}
$$ $ ${}
>>> want f.rr
-- expands both forms, adjacent --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

${NAME} $NAME $NAME${NAME}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 22
Content-Type: text/plain

value value valuevalue
-- does not re-expand a value --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

${DOLLAR}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 15
Content-Type: text/plain

a$NAME b${NAME}
-- leaves dollars that are not names --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

{"price":"$5"}
$$ $ ${}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 23
Content-Type: text/plain

{"price":"$5"}
$$ $ ${}
